method: Display metadata only. Edition links supplied by the user are manually confirmed edition overrides, including GFWL exports labelled Xbox360. Complete source sets and pack counts/Gamerscore reconcile. Xbox achievement IDs/names are retained. Names are compared ignoring case, punctuation and diacritics; explicit name corrections are recorded. Other renamed achievements require identical requirement text and matching Gamerscore. Duplicate names require unique descriptions or membership in the same pack. Missing export Gamerscore is accepted only when the complete achievement set matches by name; every supplied score must agree. No list positions, events or account progress are used. Existing 1146 title mappings remain unchanged.
